title: Toilets don’t flush the opposite way south of the equator
body: The Coriolis effect, caused by Earth’s rotation, is real and steers huge weather systems: hurricanes spin anticlockwise in the Northern Hemisphere and clockwise in the Southern. But it only matters over large distances and long times. In a sink or toilet that drains in seconds, it is far weaker than the shape of the bowl and the way the water entered. Only carefully controlled experiments with very still water can detect it.
